constant.difference_direction: native real M minus intervention at identical saved adapter and head

shuffled.difference_direction: native real M minus intervention at identical saved adapter and head

condition_scale.scope: PRE_REAL saved traces at steps16,64,128; a single TRAIN image, not all TRAIN16

formulas.residual: saved_residual_scale * F.linear(gelu(content + condition * mass_column), up.weight, up.bias)
formulas.precision: FP32 adapter arithmetic; residual cast to saved source dtype before addition

established: Saved traces show a small M preactivation relative to content preactivation for one TRAIN image.
True-M versus constant/shuffled endpoint interventions change scores but do not change any prediction.
Saved step records report nonzero adapter/head updates and zero no-grad/VJP replay score discrepancy.
Training repeatedly presents eight RAW-correct queries followed by eight RAW-incorrect queries.
not_established: The traced image establishes neither all-TRAIN activation statistics nor a unique failure cause.
Nonzero intervention effects exclude complete M removal but do not establish useful M use.
This audit does not identify how much the head schedule, condition scale, or training budget causes failure.
A proposed fixed condition gain is an untested controlled intervention, not a demonstrated repair.

proposed_minimal_intervention.definition: Multiply the existing standardized M input by fixed sqrt(hidden_size), preserving architecture and output head.
proposed_minimal_intervention.comparison: Match initialization, parameters, training schedule and budget across real, constant and fixed within-query shuffled M.
proposed_minimal_intervention.scope: TRAIN16 fit and causal-use diagnostic; no generalization claim or requirement to exceed the external head.
